Class SysMLAnything

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
Direct Known Subclasses:
SysMLAnnotationsCollection, SysMLAttributeType, SysMLBindingConnector, SysMLComment, SysMLConcernsCollection, SysMLDependency, SysMLDocumentation, SysMLHyperlink, SysMLHyperlinksCollection, SysMLOccurrence, SysMLQuantityKind, SysMLQuantityKindsCollection, SysMLRequirementsCollection, SysMLRiskLevel, SysMLSnapshot, SysMLStateMachine, SysMLTextualRepresentation, SysMLTimeSlice, SysMLTransition, SysMLUnit, SysMLUnitsCollection, SysMLViewpointsCollection
public abstract class SysMLAnything extends Object
SysMLinJava representation of the base class of all SysML model elements, the "Anything" class.

Base class for all SysML model element classes

The SysMLAnything is an abstract class that provides the basic SysMLinJava class attributes such as a name and ID number as well as a logger. Virtually all of the other SysMLinJava elements such as SysMLPart, SysMLAttributeValue, SysMLSignal, and all of the SysMLStateMachine-related elements are extensions of the SysMLAnything.

Create/initialize methods

The SysMLAnything provides a series of overrideable method calls to create any annotations or metadata of the represented SysML class. The SysMLAnything constructor automatically invokes these methods to create the annotations and metadata (problems, rationales, hyperlinks, etc) so that extensions to the SysMLAnything need only override the createXxxx() methods for the applicable annotation or metadata fields declared in the class to ensure the features are created/initialized in the correct and complete sequence needed. The overridable createXxxx() methods provide a "reminder" to create and initialize the class's annoations and metadata as well as a framework for their complete definition.

ModelerOne

    • identityString

      public String identityString()
      Overridable operation for the identity String for this object for use in logging and other display outputs. This default implementation returns the object's name, if present, or the class's name if not. If the id is set to a value greater than 0, then the id is concatenated. (If the id is to be concatenated to the identity string, then set the id to an integer value greater than 0). If an array index value is present, the index (in square brackets) is concatenated to the string.

      Extensions of the SysMLAnything can override this operation to provide an arbitrarily formatted identity string as desired.

      Returns:
      the identity string for this SysMLAnything object

    • createComments

      protected void createComments()
      Overridable operation that creates and initializes the class's comments. An example follows: 
      	{
		&#64;Comment
		SysMLComment workInProgress;
			:
		&#64;Override
		protected void createComments()
		{
			workInProgress = new SysMLComment("Component model is still a work in progress, i.e. performed action is TBD");
		}
	}

    • createIssues

      protected void createIssues()
      Overridable operation that creates and initializes the class's issues. An example follows: 
      	{
		&#64;Issue
		SysMLIssue heatIssue;
		&#64;Issue
		SysMLIssue powerIssue;
			:
		&#64;Override
		protected void createIssues()
		{
			heatIssue = new SysMLIssue("Convective heat exceeds requirements");
			powerIssue = new SysMLIssue("Electrical power voltage likely to be unstable");
		}
	}

      where the the target of the assignment operation is the name of a field annotated with the &#64;Issue annotation and of type SysMLIssue. The assigned value is the SysMLIssue's constructor with initialization parameters as appropriate.
